repository.description: Async (Celery) image repository. Empty: `ghcr.io/unxwares/taiga-back` or `docker.io/taigaio/taiga-back`, from `global.imageProvider`.

podSecurityContext.description: Pod security context. Empty: `global.podSecurityContext`, else the defaults of `global.imageProvider` (see Security in the README).

securityContext.description: Container security context. Empty: `global.securityContext`, else the defaults of `global.imageProvider`.

erlangCookie.description: Deprecated: RabbitMQ 4 ignores the RABBITMQ_ERLANG_COOKIE variable; a cookie is generated in the data volume.

existingSecret.description: Existing secret with the broker credentials.

password.description: Broker password. Leave empty to generate one (kept across upgrades).

podSecurityContext.description: Pod security context (rabbitmq alpine image user: uid 100, gid 101).

replicaCount.description: Async broker replicas (keep 1: the chart does not configure a RabbitMQ cluster).

existingSecret.description: Existing secret with the SMTP credentials.

password.description: SMTP password (stored in the chart secret).

repository.description: Backend image repository. Empty: `ghcr.io/unxwares/taiga-back` or `docker.io/taigaio/taiga-back`, from `global.imageProvider`.

podSecurityContext.description: Pod security context. Empty: `global.podSecurityContext`, else the defaults of `global.imageProvider` (see Security in the README).

securityContext.description: Container security context. Empty: `global.securityContext`, else the defaults of `global.imageProvider`.

startupProbe.description: Startup probe (the first start runs the database migrations).

existingSecret.description: Existing secret holding the user and password (overrides auth.user / auth.password).

password.description: Database password. Leave empty to generate one (kept across upgrades).

enabled.description: Deploy a bundled PostgreSQL (single pod, for small instances; prefer an operator-managed database in production).

podSecurityContext.description: Pod security context (postgres alpine image user: uid/gid 70).

repository.description: Events image repository. Empty: `ghcr.io/unxwares/taiga-events` or `docker.io/taigaio/taiga-events`, from `global.imageProvider`.

podSecurityContext.description: Pod security context. Empty: `global.podSecurityContext`, else the defaults of `global.imageProvider` (see Security in the README).

securityContext.description: Container security context. Empty: `global.securityContext`, else the defaults of `global.imageProvider`.

erlangCookie.description: Deprecated: RabbitMQ 4 ignores the RABBITMQ_ERLANG_COOKIE variable; a cookie is generated in the data volume.

existingSecret.description: Existing secret with the broker credentials.

password.description: Broker password. Leave empty to generate one (kept across upgrades).

vhost.description: Virtual host. taiga-events hard-codes `taiga`: do not change it.

podSecurityContext.description: Pod security context (rabbitmq alpine image user: uid 100, gid 101).

enabled.description: Use an external PostgreSQL database (set `db.enabled` and disable this to use the bundled one).

existingSecret.description: Existing secret holding the connection settings.

password.description: Database password (stored in the chart secret). Required unless `existingSecret` is set.

repository.description: Frontend image repository. Empty: `ghcr.io/unxwares/taiga-front` or `docker.io/taigaio/taiga-front`, from `global.imageProvider`.

podSecurityContext.description: Pod security context. Empty: `global.podSecurityContext`, else the defaults of `global.imageProvider` (see Security in the README).

securityContext.description: Container security context. Empty: `global.securityContext`, else the defaults of `global.imageProvider`.

podSecurityContext.description: Pod security context (nginx-unprivileged runs as uid 101).

existingSecret.description: Existing secret used for every service. It must expose all the keys referenced in `secretKeys` (plus POSTGRES_USER/POSTGRES_PASSWORD and RABBITMQ_USER/RABBITMQ_PASS when the bundled services use it).

extraEnv.description: Extra environment variables for every Taiga service.

extraEnvFrom.description: Extra envFrom sources for every Taiga service.

imageProvider.description: Images used by the components that leave `image.repository` empty. `unxwares`: `ghcr.io/unxwares` images rebuilt every week from the upstream sources on current Alpine bases, with the upstream security fixes not released yet, running as a non-root user with a read-only root filesystem, OIDC plugin built in (https://github.com/UnxWares/helm/tree/main/images). `upstream`: the official `docker.io/taigaio` images and `docker.io/library/postgres`, which start as root and drop privileges.

imagePullSecrets.description: Image pull secrets for every pod.

digest.description: Image digest (takes precedence over the tag).

name.description: Image replacing the backend (also used by async) image when OIDC is enabled (only needed with `upstream` images).

useXForwardedHost.description: Enable if running behind reverse proxy with TLS termination.

clientSecret.description: OIDC client secret (stored in the chart secret; ignored with `existingSecret`).

enabled.description: Enable OIDC login. The plugin is built into the UnxWares images; with `upstream` images, set OIDC-enabled images in `global.oidc.frontend.overrideImage` and `global.oidc.backend.overrideImage`.

existingSecret.description: Existing secret with the client ID and secret.

digest.description: Image digest (takes precedence over the tag).

name.description: Image replacing the frontend image when OIDC is enabled (only needed with `upstream` images).

accessMode.description: Access mode. With ReadWriteOnce, backend, async and gateway are scheduled on the same node (pod affinity added by the chart); use ReadWriteMany to spread them. An existing claim keeps its original mode.

enabled.description: Persist uploaded attachments and exports, shared by backend, async and gateway. Without it, attachments cannot be downloaded and are lost when the backend pod restarts.

nodeSelector.description: Default node selector for every pod.

podSecurityContext.description: Default pod security context (used when a component does not set its own).

resources.description: Default resources (used when a component does not set its own).

secretKey.description: Django secret key shared by back, async, events and protected. Leave empty to generate one (kept across upgrades).
Key of the Django secret key in `existingSecret`.

securityContext.description: Default container security context (used when a component does not set its own).

automount.description: Taiga never talks to the Kubernetes API: the token is not mounted.

subPath.description: Sub-path when Taiga is not served at the root of the domain.

enabled.description: Send anonymous usage telemetry to Taiga.
Expose Taiga through a Gateway API HTTPRoute (to the gateway service).

parentRefs.description: Gateways this route is attached to.

annotations.description: Ingress annotations (websockets must be allowed on /events; raise the body size for uploads).

enabled.description: Expose Taiga through an Ingress (to the gateway).

repository.description: Protected image repository. Empty: `ghcr.io/unxwares/taiga-protected` or `docker.io/taigaio/taiga-protected`, from `global.imageProvider`.

podSecurityContext.description: Pod security context. Empty: `global.podSecurityContext`, else the defaults of `global.imageProvider` (see Security in the README).

securityContext.description: Container security context. Empty: `global.securityContext`, else the defaults of `global.imageProvider`.
